research.title: CLVR: Transaction Ordering in DeFi
research.description: Examining how transaction ordering in blockchains impacts decentralized finance. The CLVR protocol shows that minimizing intra-block price volatility through strategic ordering can substantially reduce slippage-induced failure rates, revealing a feedback loop where execution failures erode liquidity.
research.details: Our work explores novel ordering rules for DeFi protocols and decentralized exchanges, payment routing enhancements (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning), and protocol-level enforcement without relying on block builders.

research.title: Computing on Satellites
research.description: Exploring satellites as secure computing platforms. Satellites carrying purpose-built payloads offer unique security properties: impenetrability, manufacturer independence, immunity to side-channel attacks, and tamper-proofing.
research.details: In a joint bluepaper with SpaceComputer IO, we shared a preliminary vision and architecture of a secure orbital compute platform. We continue to work along various research tracks on enhancing the security and performance of computations in orbit.

capstone.title: Turbocharging Authenticated Storage for Blockchains
capstone.description: Optimizing Avalanche blockchain storage through refined key-value pair management using the Firewood design, implemented in Golang.
